newsitem.title: UK: Travis Perkins three month sales ahead.
newsitem.headline: Travis Perkins three month sales ahead.

text.p: Travis Perkins Plc, Britain's third largest builders' merchant, said on Wednesday that like for like sales in the first three months of the current year are ahead of the same period a year ago.
The company told shareholders at its annual meeting that new housing starts and housing transactions continue to show a "significant increase" over a year ago.
"If economic conditions remain favourable we can look forward to a better year," said chairman Tony Travis.
Shares in the company moved ahead on the announcement to stand 13-1/2p higher at 487-1/2p by 1244 GMT.
